model_output.verdict: An elementary teacher with classroom leadership, family engagement, and measurable reading growth.
write_up: This is a strong teaching resume! A recruiter can see the students you teach, the team you lead, and the reading growth your class made. The assessment line is the model: it names the measure and shows how it changed over three years.

The committee line in your 2nd Grade Teacher role leaves one question about your contribution, but the rest gives a recruiter plenty to work with. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back; how competitive a teaching job is will matter too.

cards.line: - Raised the class's average reading growth on the district assessment from 0.8 to 1.4 grade levels per year over three years
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It connects your teaching to a named district assessment and gives the starting and ending figures.

cards.line: - Served on the school's positive behavior support committee
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see which committee you joined, but not what you did on it. One contribution would show how you supported the school's work.
cards.example: Served on the school's positive behavior support committee and [what you did]
cards.question: What did you contribute to the positive behavior support committee?

fit.note: Your experience points toward elementary classroom teaching, with grade-level leadership and work with English language learners. Your Washington K-8 certification and English Language Learner endorsement are easy to find.
